why: Two runs of one setting on the small test bed differ by up to 0.03: the plain stack scored 1.9860, 1.9855 and 1.9578 at seeds 20001 to 20003 on one GPU, and depth 12 at 113,000 pulses scored 1.9064 on the server's CPU and 1.8557 on its GPU at the same seed. Single-seed gains of 0.01 were reversed at the next seed twice today. From here on a test-bed candidate is judged over four seeds, each paired with the plain stack at the same seed, so that both share their data order.

arms.dn12: depth at equal parameters: 12 levels with half the read width (128) and half the cells (511) of the plain stack, so its parameters match the 6-level stack's; budget 113,000. Seeds 20001 to 20004.
arms.dn12b: the same with its budget doubled to 226,000, since a level's own pulses helped depth by 0.02 (GPU) to 0.065 (CPU). Seeds 20001 to 20004.
arms.sg: shunting gated cells, seeds 20003 and 20004, beside 20001 (1.9763) and 20002 (1.9871).
arms.g6: the plain stack, seed 20004, beside 20001 to 20003.

measure: Averaged validation in windows at 6,000 updates (64 batches), on the server's GPU 1, code v16x.
pass_mark: A candidate passes if it is ahead of the plain stack at the same seed in at least three of four seeds and its mean paired gain is at least 0.010. A pass nominates it for full size; it does not by itself claim a gain at full size.
seen_before_recording: The plain stack's seeds 20001 to 20003 and the shunting cells' seeds 20001 and 20002, as above; no run of dn12 or dn12b exists.

results.verdict: No candidate passes. Depth at equal parameters is ahead in three seeds but by 0.0016 on average; doubling its pulses makes it worse in three of four seeds; shunting gated cells are ahead in two. The deep stack's four seeds span 0.0035 against the plain stack's 0.028. Its learning curves (means over four seeds) lead by 0.026 at 750 updates and 0.001 at 6,000: a faster start, not a better slope. Beside the 12-level stacks with twice the parameters, a doubled budget helped depth (s12b against s12); at equal parameters it hurts, so what the stack needs is pulses for each cell, not for each level.
